caption: LUM-1317 composer paging: a draft taller than the composer window (12 rows in an 8-row window) owns PageUp/PageDown, so the key pages the draft while the transcript stays on the tail; the window follows the caret one row at a time and reports the rows it hides (`↑N` above, `↓N` below) in the label column. The last two panels show the other owner: once the draft fits again the very same chord scrolls the chat log and the jump-to-latest pill appears. Every frame is a real PTY at 76x26 driving the debug binary built from this commit; `↑`/`↓` are asserted on the pyte grid.

panels.label: 1. idle: one composer row, `? for help` in the header
2. /help fills the transcript past one viewport (the transcript is what PageUp used to own)
3. a 12-row draft: the composer window shows 8 rows, so 4 are hidden above the caret and `↑4` says so

probe.why: the window starts on draft row 4 and marks the 4 rows it is hiding above
the caret is on the draft's last row, inside the window

reject.why: the head of the draft is scrolled off, not painted
typing did not detach the transcript; the viewport still follows the tail

panels.label: 4. PgUp with an overflowing draft: the caret jumps one page (11 → 3) and the window follows it one row (4 → 3); the transcript does NOT move

probe.why: page 8 rows up lands the caret on draft row 3, which the marker row also carries

reject.why: the window followed the caret instead of staying at the tail
the load-bearing one: PgUp paged the composer, so the chat log never detached

panels.label: 5. one Up: the window moves exactly one row (3 → 2), not a page

probe.why: one keystroke, one row of scroll — the caret left the window's top row

panels.label: 6. one more Up: the last visible row now reports the rows below the window (`↓3`)

probe.why: the caret is on draft row 1
draft rows 9..11 are hidden below the window

panels.label: 7. Up onto draft row 0: the first row keeps the `> ` label and `↓4` closes the window

probe.why: the draft's own first row always keeps the label
4 rows are hidden below the window's last row

reject.why: nothing is hidden above the window any more

panels.label: 8. PgDn from row 0 still pages the draft (0 → 8, a windowful) and the transcript still does not move

probe.why: the window starts one row down
the caret is on the window's last row, which is also where the ↓ marker lives

reject.why: the chat log was not the thing that paged

panels.label: 9. Ctrl+C clears the 12-row draft and a fresh two-row draft fits the window, so it paints no marker (the cleared one-row state is panel 1)

probe.why: the label row of a composer the window can hold
the caret is on the second and last row, nothing is windowed

reject.why: a draft that fits hides nothing, so it paints no marker
and reports nothing below it either

panels.label: 10. the same PgUp with a fitting draft scrolls the chat log instead: the jump-to-latest pill appears and the composer stays put

probe.why: the transcript detached: the key went to tui.altScreen.pageUp as before LUM-1317
